observations.behavior: The scrub script now unsets all matched properties for each person in a single API call rather than looping through every property individually.
observations.posthog_connection: This reduces the number of HTTP requests and potential rate-limiting issues when removing multiple properties from many users. It also changes how bulk deletions are reported, counting total values deleted instead of pairs.

observations.posthog_connection: Helps support engineers diagnose why certain user-property combinations could not be removed without changing account permissions or role assignments.
